evals.prompt: Make a professional general-audience Word brief on human evolution with a sourced infographic, evidence table, limitations and linked references.
evals.expected_output: Editable DOCX with semantic headings, original captioned figure and alt text, defensible claims and zero strict structural warnings; rendered page review when available.
assertions: Every embedded image has descriptive alt text
References are clickable and claims use matching source IDs

evals.prompt: Turn these incident notes into a two-page Word report with an executive summary, timeline, impact and next actions; don't invent owners or metrics.
evals.expected_output: Concise editable report, explicit unknowns, semantic headings and stable pagination verified by rendering.
assertions: Requested length is verified or labelled unverified

evals.prompt: Create a printable Word comparison of three energy technologies with a multi-page table and references; make it easy to read in grayscale.
evals.expected_output: DOCX with repeated table headers, unsplit rows, readable labels and citations; no colour-only distinctions.
assertions: No meaning depends on colour alone
